technique_name: Write an example of an editorial that discusses the disadvantages of online education.
description: Online education is becoming increasingly popular, but there are a number of drawbacks. Many students miss out on the structure and support that a traditional school provides, and while they may be able to work at their own pace, there is also a lack of accountability and guidance. Additionally, a computer and a stable internet connection is required for online courses, which can be hard for some students to access.
